from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Represents one paper from the collection, containing its title and outgoing references."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of this paper as it appears in the document")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="List of titles of other papers cited in this paper's reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all papers found in the document collection."""
    papers: list[Paper]
